This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This phrase redundantly combines two time expressions: 古代 already names a time period, while 的时候 also means “at the time of.” [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到很多人正在吃一些植物，Here the meaning is that 神农 perceived the scene, so use 看到 rather than 看, which means “to look.” [rule: resultative_complement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，别人 distinguishes other people from a particular person or group already under discussion; here 神农 wants to help people in general. [teacher rule: bieren]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
看到 correctly expresses noticing the people and fixes the incomplete verb form 看 in this context.
别人 wrongly means other people distinct from someone under discussion, while 人们 can refer to the group of people generally.
